en.askTitle: Swap in your own area, dates and budget and get the same monthly-rental comparison and cost sheet
en.runTitle: Canggu, Bali, January–March 2027: a remote worker’s monthly rental under USD 1,500 all-in

fields.label: City or areas
fields.value: Canggu, Bali (Berawa, Batu Bolong, Pererenan or wherever fits)

fields.label: Work hours and time zone
fields.placeholder: e.g. 9:00–17:00 Singapore time, with video calls

fields.label: Bathroom, kitchen, desk, chair and call privacy
fields.value: Reliable internet and a proper place to work; on my own

en.template: Compare 5–7 monthly rentals in {area} for {dates} and {hours}. My {scope} budget is {budget}; I need {needs}. Show rent, minimum stay, utilities/caps, cleaning, fees, deposits and cancellation terms, with original links and read dates. Separate quoted costs from allowances; include optional coworking and transport. Recommend budget-first and work-first choices, flag unknown availability/noise/network/location, and give me walkthrough, desk-speed-test and written-quote questions. Do not contact, book or pay, or call an advert confirmed vacancy.

phases.title: Re-check the listings from the earlier notes and separate live ads from dated availability
phases.judgment: It would not call an advert a vacancy: none of the pages it re-read confirms January–March 2027 availability, and a live ad with no date is not dated stock.

phases.title: Build the comparison page and the editable budget workbook
phases.note: Neighbourhood comparison, listing links and itemised monthly budgets

phases.title: Check the arithmetic, the workbook and the page, then give the recommendation
phases.judgment: Every one of the workbook’s 147 formulas was checked a second time with separate arithmetic. The full spreadsheet recalculation timed out, and the guide says so.

workers: Re-read four listing pages (Berawa, Pondok Canggu, Jubilee, Pratama) and the rental FAQ, checking prices, minimum stays and whether any January–March availability was stated

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的区域、日期和预算，得到同样的月租对比和费用表
zh.runTitle: 巴厘岛仓古，2027 年 1–3 月：远程工作者的月租房，整月预算不超过 1,500 美元

fields.label: 城市或街区
fields.value: 巴厘岛仓古(Berawa、Batu Bolong、Pererenan，或更合适的区域)

fields.label: 工作时段和时区
fields.placeholder: 例如：新加坡时间 9:00–17:00，要开视频会议

fields.label: 卫浴、厨房、书桌、椅子和通话隐私
fields.value: 网络可靠，有像样的办公位置；一个人住

zh.template: 比较{area}在{dates}的 5–7 处月租房源，我的工作时段和时区是{hours}，{scope}预算为{budget}，需要{needs}。列出租金、最短租期、水电及上限、清洁、手续费、押金和取消条款，附原始链接及查阅日期。区分报价与预留额，加入可选共享办公和交通，分别推荐省钱及办公优先方案。指出空房、噪声、网络和位置中的未知项，给我看房、书桌测速及书面报价问题。不要联系、预订或付款，也不要把广告说成已确认有房。

phases.title: 复核上次笔记里的房源，区分在线广告与有日期的空房信息
phases.judgment: 它没有把广告当成空房：复核的页面都没有确认 2027 年 1–3 月有房，没有日期的在线广告不算有日期的房源。

phases.title: 制作对比网页和可编辑的预算表格
phases.note: 街区对比、房源链接和逐项月度预算

phases.title: 检查计算、表格和网页，再给出推荐
phases.judgment: 表格里的 147 个公式都另用一套算法重新核对过。完整的表格重新计算超时了，说明里也如实写明。

workers: 重新阅读 4 个房源页面(Berawa、Pondok Canggu、Jubilee、Pratama)和租房常见问题，核对价格、最短租期，以及页面有没有写明 1–3 月是否有房

chipNames.https://rentroombali.com/property/jubile: Pererenan 的 Jubilee Studios 房源页
chipNames.https://rentroombali.com/property/pratam: Pererenan 的 Pratama Studios 房源页
